scope: In GD153's 16 fixed same-visit dither groups, predict a seed from two other bands with the GRW70 rules. Seed each donor search only from the same-band peaks at the other three dithers with an affine fit. Compare direct detector-pixel midpoint and WCS-projected midpoint against the benchmark local centroid in the evaluated exposure. Use frozen donor prominence, agreement, local re-centering and DQ checks. Score flux/color only for the four originally dual-radius clean triplets. Reuse fixed measured reference pixels and count all refusals; this is internal observational validation on GD153, not a new absolute astrometric tie.
